title: Cabinet Hardware Cabinet Pull 3-Inch Solid Brass Traditional Style | Satin Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom cabinets and drawers with cabinet hardware built from solid brass in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass. This 3-inch cabinet pull (handle) delivers a distinctive, transitional look—contemporary lines with traditional design elements—so you can coordinate a complete cabinet hardware collection and other versatile bath accessories.

- Satin Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Cabinet-mount installation; mounting screws/hardware included
- Offered in many designer finish options to coordinate your space
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Product type: Cabinet pull / cabinet handle

- Style: Traditional

- Dimensions: 3.9-inch L x 1.6-inch H x 0.9-inch W
